name: Blood Baron of Vizkopa — "you have 30 or more life and an opponent has 10 or less life" reads both halves
notes: The 'X and Y' condition split did not recognise 'an opponent has', so the whole condition went to the 'you have N or more life' branch and the opponent half was dropped: at 30 life Blood Baron got +6/+6 and flying with every opponent at 20. Player 1 30 life, Player 2 20: Blood Baron stays 4/4 without flying. The positive case is in opponent-life-conditions. Memory: project_opponent_life_conditions_2026-10-14.
